Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound on the main roadway in Pasadena, Texas, and entered a signalized intersection on
a green light when Driver 2, southbound, proceeded into the intersection and struck the driver side of Driver 1's
vehicle. Driver 1 reported dizziness and a headache immediately after the impact and complained of a
concussion-type injury at the scene. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat and was also present in the
vehicle at the time of the collision. Driver 2 stated that he did not see the signal change in time and admitted that the
collision occurred as Driver 1 described. Two independent witnesses, one standing at the corner and one in a parked
car, gave statements consistent with that account. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver side
door, quarter panel and window frame that is consistent with a side impact of this type. No prior damage was
observed on the vehicle, and no earlier collision damage was reported by either party. Driver 1 is listed as the named
insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Injuries reported by Driver 1 are consistent with the forces involved in a
crash of this nature, and Driver 1 was transported for medical evaluation.
